tagline: South into the Page Valley, with crystals under the hill.
intro: Out of Front Royal, US 340 heads into the Page Valley, the valley of the South Fork of the Shenandoah between the Blue Ridge and Massanutten Mountain. It runs through Bentonville and leaves Warren County at Overall, crossing Overall Run on a deck truss bridge beside the railroad's own.

A mile south of Front Royal, Skyline Caverns holds anthodites, six-sided crystals of pure calcite. They turned up when workers clearing the cave floor of mud opened an area that mud had blocked for many years.

moments.title: Skyline Caverns
moments.text: Guided tours go down to 260 feet below ground, and the anthodites, protected by state law, wait behind closed doors that a guide must open.

moments.title: Bentonville
moments.text: Shenandoah River State Park lies along the South Fork near this village on US 340.

moments.title: Overall Bridge
moments.text: The 1938 Pratt deck arch truss carries the highway over Overall Run, next to the railway's bridge.
